note: OBIS matches submitted scientific names or WoRMS LSIDs against WoRMS and includes the resulting taxonomic information in its occurrence exports. Synonyms resolve to accepted names. This is taxonomic enrichment during OBIS ingestion; no fixed refresh schedule or latest taxonomic snapshot date is established.
